cases.what: the starting values on the staircase: the steady gain curve, the soft knee from -23.5 to -8.5 dB
Knee 0 and Ratio 4 on the staircase: a hard corner at -16 dB, a quarter of the rise above it
Ratio 0.4 (it expands above the threshold) and Release 1 ms: louder above -16 dB, held at full level by the Output Limit
a step from -40 to 0 dB and back, Knee 0, Ratio 4: the attack (6 ms) and the two-speed Auto Release
the same step with Auto Release off: one slow release of 440 ms
Attack 0: the cut is whole on the step's first sample
Makeup Gain +12 dB and Output Limit -6 dB: louder, the loud part held at -6 dB
Threshold keyed from -40 dB (frame 0) to -10 dB (frame 10) over a steady -20 dB: the cut eases off
Ratio keyed from 1 (frame 0) to 20 (frame 12) at 29.97 over a steady -20 dB
frames 40 to 59 of fx_comp_004 alone: the same samples as the whole mix there
a layer starting at frame 6 with a level of -6 dB: the compressor counts from the layer's start, before the level
the compressor switched off: the sound unchanged
a Noise Gate (Threshold -30 dB) then a compressor: the gate shuts the quiet part first
a Ratio of 50, outside 0.4 to 30: kept, EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID, the sound unchanged
an Auto Release of "sometimes": kept, EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID, the sound unchanged
the right channel's step drives both: the quiet left is turned down with it

refused.what: Compressor on a solid layer is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID
an expression on a Compressor number is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID: sound effects take keys only
a Mix on Compressor is PROJECT_SCHEMA_INVALID: a sound effect has no Mix
